verdict.rationale: Dover documents an API for adding candidates, listing hires, and hosting a careers page. Nothing in the evidence shows API versioning or a documented deprecation policy, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the common paths. Having an API is not the same as having a versioned API with a deprecation policy, so this earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
